name: ci-workflows
//: The GitHub Actions workflows and their contract checks: lint is the live-e2e matrix drift gate (scripts/check-e2e-matrix.sh, an input here) and test is the workflow-contract suite (.github/tests) — the gate's fixed status-check contexts, the per-event tier routing (.github/scripts/gate-tier.mjs), the pr-title rules, and the drift gate's own pass/fail journeys. release-plz.toml is an input because the pr-title types must match its changelog parsers.
